author: akritkbehera
body:
LLVM 23 replaced LocationContext with StackFrame and made
  NestedNameSpecifier a value type, which broke the build of
  Utilities/StaticAnalyzers.

  - Use CheckerContext::getStackFrame() instead of the removed getLocationContext(), and clang::StackFrame instead of clang::LocationContext.
  - Rename LocationOrAnalysisDeclContext to StackFrameOrAnalysisDeclContext.
  - UsingNamespace: take the qualifier by value and only read the namespace name when its kind is Kind::Namespace.
title: [DO NOT MERGE] StaticAnalyzers: adapt to LLVM 23 API changes
